rubricScores.label: Silhouette / massing
rubricScores.notes: Reference has stepped crown, corner bay/oriel, and a clear base plinth. Kit is a single extruded rectangle with flat slab roof.

rubricScores.label: Facade rhythm
rubricScores.notes: Kit has regular bay grid. Reference mixes arched decorative panels, flat windows, and a corner vertical accent — more hierarchical than the kit stamp.

rubricScores.label: Opening depth
rubricScores.notes: Upper punched windows on the ref sit deep in brick with arch frames. Kit openings read as surface-mounted boxes.

rubricScores.label: Trim layering
rubricScores.notes: Reference cornice and upper decorative bands cast strong shadow. Kit ornate-trim setting does not produce a clay-readable crown stack.

rubricScores.label: Storefront / base
rubricScores.notes: Reference red commercial base is ~1/3 height with large arched openings. Kit ground is only modestly different from upper floors — no tall arcade storefront massing.

rubricScores.label: Side / rear hierarchy
rubricScores.notes: Kit side is simpler than front. Reference side/return is still secondary; corner bay breaks the box in a way the kit cannot yet.

freeformNotes: Compared same kit clay capture against Brooklyn Vanderbilt. Storefront base height + arched ground openings are the clearest product gap after cornice. Corner bay is a later grammar item, not a G8 regression.
